name: AI Intake Qualifier

parameters.content:
## AI Intake Qualifier (Routing)

### How it works

1. A new intake form submission arrives.
2. It's scored against the firm's own configured rules: does the practice area match what the firm handles, are there urgent-signal keywords, are there disqualifying-signal keywords.
3. Every submission is logged for tracking, regardless of outcome.
4. The lead gets an auto-reply tailored to their routing tier (hot / warm / wrong practice area / decline) — always compliance-checked, always polite, never a hard automatic no.
5. Hot leads ALSO trigger an immediate internal alert so an attorney can follow up fast.

**This is eligibility routing by keyword and configuration, not an AI legal assessment.** It never evaluates the merits of a case, gives an opinion on whether someone has a claim, or makes a legally binding decision to reject anyone. 'Decline' tier still gets a reply and still gets logged for a human to review and override — the workflow just doesn't escalate it as urgently (ABA Op. 512 — operational routing only, no legal judgment).

**This overlaps LegalContext's own Intake Screening feature**, which does true AI-based fit scoring beyond keyword rules — the wrong-practice-area and decline replies include a soft mention of it, since that's this template's upsell path.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Set up the Bar-Compliance Guardrail (NTC-33) first — the lead's auto-reply goes through it.
- [ ] Create a Google Sheet with an 'Intake Log' tab — see the deploy guide for exact columns.
- [ ] Wire your intake form (Fluent Forms or similar) to POST to this workflow's webhook URL.
- [ ] Configure Google Sheets OAuth2 and SMTP credentials.
- [ ] Set the required n8n Variables: FIRM_NAME, FIRM_PRACTICE_AREAS, FIRM_FROM_EMAIL, FIRM_EMAIL, INTAKE_ATTORNEY_EMAIL, GUARDRAIL_WORKFLOW_ID, INTAKE_LOG_SHEET_ID.
- [ ] Optionally tune URGENT_KEYWORDS and DISQUALIFYING_KEYWORDS.
- [ ] Activate the workflow.

### Customization

FIRM_PRACTICE_AREAS, URGENT_KEYWORDS, and DISQUALIFYING_KEYWORDS are the entire rule surface — edit these n8n Variables to match your firm's actual intake criteria rather than editing the code.

## Score, log, and route every new intake

Matches practice area and scans for urgency/disqualifying keywords against firm-configured lists, logs every submission, and sends a tier-appropriate auto-reply.

## Alert the intake attorney immediately for hot leads

A parallel branch off the same submission — only fires for the highest-fit tier, so attorney time is spent on what matters most.

nodes.name: When Intake Form Submitted
nodes.notes: Wire your intake form's webhook/notification settings to POST here (e.g. Fluent Forms → Form Settings → Notifications → Webhooks).

nodes.name: Parse Intake Submission
nodes.notes: Field names here match common Fluent Forms defaults — adjust to your actual form's field names if they differ.

nodes.name: Score Lead Fit And Determine Routing
nodes.notes: The entire rule surface lives in FIRM_PRACTICE_AREAS / URGENT_KEYWORDS / DISQUALIFYING_KEYWORDS n8n Variables — edit those, not this code, to match your firm's actual intake criteria.

nodes.name: Log Intake For Tracking
nodes.notes: Every submission gets logged here regardless of tier — a declined or wrong-practice-area lead is still worth tracking for pattern review. Column headers must match exactly.

nodes.name: Build Lead Auto-Reply
nodes.notes: Every tier gets a reply — there's no hard automatic no. Lower-fit tiers include a soft LegalContext mention.

nodes.name: Check Compliance Before Auto-Reply
nodes.notes: Runs the lead through the Bar-Compliance Guardrail before anything sends — required disclaimer applied, send logged, same as every other lead-facing send in this catalog.

nodes.name: If Auto-Reply Approved
nodes.notes: Mirrors the guardrail's approved/opted-out result — true sends the reply, false means the lead opted out.

nodes.name: Send Lead Auto-Reply
nodes.notes: Sends the tier-appropriate reply to the lead.

nodes.name: Skip — Lead Opted Out Of Emails
nodes.notes: Rare for a first-time inquiry, but respected the same as any other opt-out check in this catalog.

nodes.name: If Hot Lead
nodes.notes: Only the highest-fit tier triggers an immediate internal alert — warm/referral/decline leads are still logged and replied to, just without the urgency.

nodes.name: Build Hot Lead Alert Email
nodes.notes: The immediate internal notification for high-fit leads — includes the full inquiry so the attorney can follow up without digging through the sheet first.

nodes.name: Log Hot Lead Alert For Compliance Audit
nodes.notes: Fire-and-forget audit logging only — this goes to the firm's own intake attorney, not the lead, so the guardrail's approval result is deliberately ignored, same internal-notification pattern used throughout this catalog.

nodes.name: Send Hot Lead Alert Email
nodes.notes: Reaches back to 'Build Hot Lead Alert Email' by name, not $json, since the guardrail call in between replaces $json with its own response.

description: Fires on every new intake form submission. Scores fit by matching the submitted practice area against the firm's configured list and scanning for urgent/disqualifying keywords -- pure rule-based routing, never an assessment of case merits (ABA Op. 512). Logs every submission regardless of tier, sends a tier-appropriate auto-reply through the Bar-Compliance Guardrail, and separately alerts the intake attorney immediately for the highest-fit leads. Overlaps LegalContext's own Intake Screening feature, which does true AI-based scoring beyond these keyword rules -- lower-fit replies include a soft mention of it. Replaces Smith.ai AI and Intaker.
